# Radoslav Radev Recommends Sticking to a Consistent Planche Training Method

Radoslav Radev recommends sticking to a consistent planche training method or program long enough to see measurable results before changing it. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 03:53]

## Details

- Changing training methods every month prevents seeing results from any approach. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 03:15]
- Radev reports wasting months on planche by switching exercises every time someone told him something different. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 03:31]
- Stick to a strategy until you see real results or confirm you are not seeing results before changing. [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 04:36]
- Do not jump to fix a different technique mistake while still making a more important mistake (e.g., fixing head position while core is still relaxed). [src: vid-G331KArPXnI @ 04:16]

## Evidence

- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 03:15 (Radoslav Radev): "you keep changing your training method every single month one month you're trying the method second month you're trying something new and you actually never stop to see the results from the training methods"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 03:31 (Radoslav Radev): "i remember how everyone telling me different things and i was listening to everyone he telling me something like you have to focus more on this exercise because this exercise helping i'm doing it after one week two weeks or one month i'm forget about this exercise because someone better than him told me other exercise"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 03:53 (Radoslav Radev): "i never stick to a plan to a program to see the data to see the results to see from this amount of time what is my result how many seconds more i can hold or what are the other progressions that i'm going"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 04:36 (Radoslav Radev): "stick to one strategy plan that you you can make for the future and until you see real results or you're not seeing results don't change it"
- vid-G331KArPXnI @ 04:16 (Radoslav Radev): "you know that your car [core] on the planche is relaxed and you know this is really important mistake and you can't continue the planche with relaxed core when you see some video in instagram how the head position like this is really important to be fixed or something like this don't jump on a head"
